//! The clock as an un-called function pointer: a path in expression
//! position with no call at all.

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn a_case() -> fn() -> std::time::Instant {
    std::time::Instant::now
}
